security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Native shell for the cwcli Console.
bundle.longDescription: Caffeinated Whale Desktop supervises one cwcli daemon on loopback and opens the Console in a native window. Every Docker, bench, and Frappe rule stays in the cwcli Python core.
